methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: technical considerations for the integration of energy management functionalities into an ERP system are described with a focus on a system coupling approach

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software design paper: describes an ERP-EMS system-coupling architecture, seven use cases, and a prototype implementation (abas ERP + ENIT EMS). No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued; energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally, with no model variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identifiable.

paper_type.evidence_quote: we developed a prototype of an ERP system with integrated energy management functionalities

stage1.notes: Applies to SME discrete manufacturing (milling, laser cutting, stamping); energy data are metered/aggregated and CO2 computed, but no EnPI/EnB normalisation model is built.
